name: case-brief
title: Investigation case brief
for_each: select id,code from cases order by code

sections.title: Actions
sections.sql: select name,owner,due_on,status,result from actions where case_id=$1 order by due_on

sections.title: Interviews
sections.sql: select i.name,p.name as party,i.owner,i.scheduled_at,i.status,i.notes from interviews i join parties p on p.id=i.party_id where i.case_id=$1 order by i.scheduled_at

sections.title: Recorded notes
sections.sql: select created_at,name,body,actor from notes where case_id=$1 order by created_at

name: custody-register
title: Evidence custody register
for_each: select id,code from evidence order by code

sections.title: Recorded transfers
sections.sql: select sequence,created_at,from_holder,to_holder,location,reason,actor from custody where evidence_id=$1 order by sequence
sections.note: Recorded events and a file hash support review. They do not establish admissibility or prove an unbroken physical chain.
